local_context.value: On the Lake Wales Ridge, elevation 128 ft, population 16,361 (2020); city 1925. Hurricane-force winds from Charley, Frances and Jeanne (2004) and Irma (2017). 1920s land-boom commercial historic district.

neighborhoods.value: PARTIAL, listing-site sources only (Wikipedia names none): Lake Ashton (gated active community), Mountain Lake, Carlsberg Estates, Chalet Estates, Lake Haven Estates, Mohawk Groves.

place_entities.value: 1) Bok Tower Gardens. 2) Spook Hill. 3) Lake Wales Commercial Historic District. 4) Lake Wales History Museum. Also Chalet Suzanne and Grassy Lake Preserve.

permit_office.value: City of Lake Wales Building Division, Municipal Administration Building, 201 W. Central Ave., Permitting@LakeWalesFL.gov, 8-5 Mon-Fri. The city form cites Florida Building Code 8th Edition; confirm the current edition.
